verdict.rationale: Rev AI is an API-first product. Its docs cover a public Asynchronous Speech-to-Text API with a get-started tutorial, a Streaming API over WebSocket and RTMP, webhooks for job completion, documented job parameters and limits, and SDKs with code samples. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404) and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
